title: The Clean Signal
text: "I've been cleaning up the Director's recordings for the archive. There was nothing to clean."

lines.text: "No noise. None. A signal that crossed light-years should be filthy. This one is cleaner than my voice in this room."
"No compression artefacts, no dropouts, no drift. Either Mission Control had equipment nobody on a dying Earth could build, or these weren't sent from Earth at all."
"I'd like to be wrong. I'd like you to tell me I'm wrong."

choices.label: "I don't know. Let's find out."
choices.reply: "Good," says the Archivist. "Then we find out." They ask for lab time. We give it.

choices.label: "It's a good archive. That's all."
choices.reply: "Yes. Too good." The Archivist leaves the recordings on the shared screen, where anyone can read the noise floor. It is flat.
